name: Penne Arrabbiata

ingredients.name: whole peeled tomatoes
ingredients.original: 2 x 400 g cans whole peeled tomatoes

steps: Heat the olive oil in a large deep frypan over medium-low heat. Add the sliced garlic and cook gently for 1-2 minutes until fragrant and just golden at the edges - don't let it brown.
Stir in the chilli flakes and cook for 30 seconds so they bloom in the oil. Use a little less or more chilli to suit how hot you like it.

Tip in the whole peeled tomatoes with their juice and crush them roughly with the back of a spoon. Season with a good pinch of salt and simmer gently for 20-25 minutes, stirring now and then, until thickened.
Meanwhile, bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil. Cook the penne for 2 minutes less than the packet says, then scoop out a cup of the pasta water and drain.
Add the penne to the sauce with a splash of the reserved pasta water. Toss over medium heat for 1-2 minutes until the sauce clings to the pasta, adding more pasta water if it looks dry.
Take the pan off the heat and stir through most of the chopped parsley. Taste and season with salt and pepper.
Serve in bowls scattered with the remaining parsley. Add a grating of vegan parmesan if you like.
